legacy-custom-sky.config.title: Legacy Custom Sky
legacy-custom-sky.options.fogBlendMode.v: Distant fog fades to the dimension's normal color, ignoring the custom sky entirely. No performance cost.
legacy-custom-sky.options.fogBlendMode.d: Distant fog fades toward a single color sampled from the custom sky in the direction you're facing. Cheap, but the whole screen gets one flat fog color, which can look off with detailed skies.
legacy-custom-sky.options.fogBlendMode.p: Terrain fog samples the actual custom sky per-pixel, so it matches what's really behind it in every direction. Most accurate; small added cost only where fog is visible on screen.
